caption: The drawing features a single, detailed object: a bonnet hat rendered with intricate linework and shading. The bonnet is depicted in a side view, oriented with its opening facing left and its crown slightly to the right. The hat displays a combination of soft pastel colors, primarily muted pinkish-brown, beige, and cream tones. The bonnet includes decorative elements such as gold-colored trim, braided bands, and looping designs along the edges. The fabric appears to be gathered with a ruched texture and is divided by horizontal stripes accented with ornate gold borders. A pale blue ribbon embellishes the side, integrated within the layered textiles. The background of the drawing is plain and unadorned, with a light beige or off-white color. In the lower right corner, there is a small, faint signature, "FERDINAND A. BASTIN," and a miniature white or silver object that resembles a thimble or hat accessory.
title: Straw Bonnet
